description:
Earnings event: 8-K acceptance timestamp, and as-reported revenue and eps_gaap from the
original report. `fiscal_year` and `fiscal_period` are required. `fiscal_period` is FY, or
Q1–Q3. A fourth-quarter release is stored as FY. This tool does not take as_of_date.

fiscal_period.description: FY, or Q1, Q2, or Q3. A fourth-quarter release is stored as FY. This tool does not take as_of_date.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year of the earnings event.

ticker.description: Issuer ticker as used by PtData, for example AAPL.

name: get_earnings_event
title: Get earnings event
